summary: Verified fix for JARVIS search bug. Backend now uses AI (gpt-5.4-mini) to generate context-aware results honoring the user's actual query (location, budget, features). Alcamo query correctly returns Alcamo results (NOT Torino), prices within budget (76k-80k <= 80k), correct Sicilian phone prefix +39 091 (Palermo province). Milano/Navigli and Roma queries also return properly localized results. DELETE endpoint physically removes both the search and its results, and returns 404 for missing ids. All 6 pytest tests PASS (100%). Frontend testIDs 'delete-search-button' (results.tsx) and 'delete-search-${id}' (history.tsx) confirmed present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses datetime.utcnow() (deprecated in Python 3.12+). Consider datetime.now(timezone.utc). Not blocking.
get_mock_results legacy fallback still exists (line 371); harmless but dead-ish code path only hit if generate_ai_results raises.
server.py is ~515 lines - approaching split threshold but still acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral searches prefixed with TEST_DELETE and clean them up via the DELETE endpoint under test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Alcamo bug is fixed. AI-driven result generation via /api/search/process is working and returns locality-aware content. If flakiness appears, note that LLM cold calls can take ~10-30s; test timeout is 120s per request. DELETE endpoint now physically removes both search and results (not soft-delete).
rca_of_issue: Root cause: previous implementation used a hardcoded get_mock_results() that always returned Torino-based listings regardless of query. Fix: replaced with generate_ai_results() using gpt-5.4-mini via emergentintegrations, which reads user query and produces context-aware results (location, price, features). Additionally DELETE now removes both search + results. Verified: Alcamo query produced 3+ results all in Alcamo, prices 76-80k, prefixes +39 091.
